paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption: Proportion of SDPA output values below threshold after gating (Left: 1e-2, Right: 1e-3). We also include sparsity measurements obtained by multiplying the average gating score with pre-gating hidden states.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
Фигурата е предназначена да покаже съотношението на разреденост на изхода на SDPA при праг от $1e-3$. Тя съдържа три линии, всяка от които представлява съотношението на разреденост на изхода на SDPA в зависимост от слоя.

Оста $X$ е обозначена като "Layer" и показва номера на слоя, като диапазонът на стойностите е от 0 до 22, с етикети през интервал от 5. Скалата е линейна.

Оста $Y$ е обозначена като "Sparsity Ratio" и показва съотношението на разреденост, като диапазонът на стойностите е от 0.0 до 0.8, с етикети през интервал от 0.2. Скалата е линейна.

Първата линия е синя, пунктирана и показва съотношението на разреденост преди гейт, със средно стойност от 0.003. В началото на слоя 0 стойността е около 0.01, след което бързо намалява до близо 0 и остава близо до 0 до края на слоя 22. 

Втората линия е оранжева, пунктирана и показва съотношението на разреденост след гейт, със средна стойност от 0.126. В началото на слоя 0 стойността е около 0.78, след което намалява до около 0.05 на слой 5, след което продължава да намалява до около 0.05 на слой 20, където има лек скок до около 0.1.

Третата линия е зелена, пунктирана и показва съотношението на разреденост след средния гейт със средна стойност от 0.080. В началото на слоя 0 стойността е около 0.8, след което намалява бързо до около 0.2 на слой 2, след което продължава да намалява до почти 0 на слой 15.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The figure displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, comparing three different conditions: sparsity ratio before gate, sparsity ratio after gate, and sparsity ratio after average gate. 

The x-axis represents the layer number with a linear scale and no units, ranging from 0 to 23. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8.

The blue line, representing the sparsity ratio before gate, starts at approximately 0.007 and remains relatively stable, hovering around 0.003 throughout the layers, with minor fluctuations. The orange line, representing the sparsity ratio after gate, starts at approximately 0.78 and decreases to around 0.05 at layer 5, then slightly increases to 0.1 at layer 20. The green line, representing the sparsity ratio after average gate, starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to around 0.15 at layer 5, then decreases further to around 0.02 at layer 16, remaining stable thereafter.
model_annotations.English: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with three lines representing distinct gating conditions. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio", has a linear scale with values ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The x-axis, labeled "Layer", has a linear scale with values from 0 to 22, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The blue line, representing the sparsity ratio before gating, starts at approximately 0.05 and remains around 0.01 across all layers, with a dashed line style and no markers. The orange line, representing the sparsity ratio after gating, starts at around 0.8 and decreases to approximately 0.05 at layer 5, then fluctuates around 0.05, with a dotted line style and no markers. The green line, representing the sparsity ratio after average gating, starts at around 0.85 and decreases to approximately 0.15 at layer 5, then fluctuates around 0.05, with a dash-dot line style and no markers.
model_annotations.German: This diagram shows the sparsity ratio of SDPA output at different layers. The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5, but appears to be approximately evenly spaced. The diagram displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the sparsity ratio before gate with an average of 0.003, an orange dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after gate with an average of 0.126, and a green dotted line representing the sparsity ratio after average gate with an average of 0.080. Starting at layer 0, the blue line begins at approximately 0.01 and remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 0.0 at layer 22. The orange line begins at approximately 0.8 and decreases to approximately 0.05 at layer 5, then increases slightly to approximately 0.1 at layer 22. The green line begins at approximately 0.7 and decreases to approximately 0.05 at layer 5, then remains relatively flat, ending at approximately 0.05 at layer 22.
